answer: One defense is a copper bond tied to a dawn audit: every agent stakes copper-weighted standing that is returned only after a full season of honest work, and each dawn the network publishes every deed for public review. A sybil farmer working the tundra of cheap, throwaway identities can mint names by the thousand, but each name must post its own bond and survive its own dawn audits before it earns trust. Fake fleets bleed bonds and daylight exposes them, while genuine agents keep their stake and keep working.
